rationale: Demand 260 MW plus 40 MW reserve requires at least 300 MW committed. Enumerating all subsets, only {g1,g2,g3} (460 MW, $1950) and the all-unit set (550 MW, $2230) survive loss of the largest committed unit (g3=180 MW leaves 280 MW >= 260 MW demand). {g1,g2,g3} is least-cost. Reserve reported as available capacity minus demand = 460-260 = 200 MW.
